# SubStrUsedAsArrayAccess

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Performance](/rules/#performance) · PhpStorm name: `SubStrUsedAsArrayAccessInspection`

Extracting a single character with `substr($str, $i, 1)` costs a function call;
string offset access (`$str[$i]`) reads the same byte directly. The proven negative
position `-1` is translated to `strlen($str) - 1`.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{5,6,7} [Before]
<?php
function peek(string $buf, ?string $maybe, string|int $mixed, array $rows, int $at)
{
    $a = substr($buf, $at, 1);
    $b = substr($buf, -1, 1);
    $c = substr($maybe, 0, 1);
    $d = substr($mixed, 2, 1);
    return [$a, $b, $c, $d];
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function peek(string $buf, ?string $maybe, string|int $mixed, array $rows, int $at)
{
    $a = substr($buf, $at, 1);
    $b = ($buf[strlen($buf) - 1] ?? '');
    $c = ($maybe[0] ?? '');
    $d = substr($mixed, 2, 1);
    return [$a, $b, $c, $d];
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 5: Use &#39;($buf[strlen($buf) - 1] ?? &#39;&#39;)&#39; (string offset access) instead.</li>
<li>line 6: Use &#39;($maybe[0] ?? &#39;&#39;)&#39; (string offset access) instead.</li>
<li>line 7: Use &#39;$mixed[2]&#39; (string offset access) instead.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "SubStrUsedAsArrayAccess": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore SubStrUsedAsArrayAccess

/**
 * @noinspection SubStrUsedAsArrayAccessInspection
 */
```
